alt: 孩子先把完整設計與零件準備好，動手組裝鳥屋時神情篤定，知道每一步該怎麼做。
scene_prompt: 胸有成竹 means having a thoroughly prepared plan and confidence before acting. Modern older child confidently assembles a small wooden birdhouse at a craft table using harmless wood glue. A COMPLETE, detailed visual blueprint of that SAME birdhouse lies OPEN next to the work, with all wood pieces neatly laid out in assembly order; partially assembled birdhouse already fits together accurately. Child looks calmly certain, knowing next step, not surprised or improvising. A faint pencil thought bubble shows the fully finished matching birdhouse, indicating the whole result is clear in mind. No writing, dimensions or numbers on diagram, only shapes. No power tools, knives, injury, trophies or money. Focus on prepared confidence.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Scene:
